blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum! Unit 2 mein khush aamdeed. Pichle unit mein hum ne complex numbers ke saath kaam kiya tha; ab hum mathematics ke sab se buniyadi idea ki taraf aa rahe hain: function. Aap shayad hairaan hon ke yeh lafz pehli dafa sun rahe hain, lekin haqeeqat yeh hai ke aap roz functions use karte hain. Petrol pump par jitne litre dalwayein, utne paise bante hain; yeh ek function hai. Mobile ka bill minutes par depend karta hai; yeh bhi function hai.

Kitab ka introduction yeh kehta hai: functions mathematics ki buniyad hain. Yeh input aur output ke darmiyan ek rule (qaida) ke zariye rishta batate hain. Domain, co-domain aur range jaise concepts samajhna zaroori hai, kyun ke inhi se hum mukhtalif qisam ke functions (one-to-one, onto aur bijective) ko pehchante hain. Graph ki madad se hum intersecting points dhoondte hain: linear function coordinate axes ko kahan kat'ta hai, do linear functions kahan milte hain, aur linear aur quadratic function kahan cross karte hain. Yeh intersections equations ko aankhon se dekh kar hal karne mein madad dete hain. Is ke ilawa square root aur cube root functions ke graphs bhi dekhenge. Yeh unit algebra aur graph dono tareeqon ko mila kar aap ki problem-solving ki salahiyat barhayega.

blocks.title: About this unit
blocks.text:
Yeh unit kis baare mein hai: aap jo bhi formula use karte hain (square ka area, petrol ki qeemat, safar ka faasla), woh asal mein ek rule hai jo ek cheez le kar doosri cheez deta hai. Unit 2 is idea ko bilkul saaf (exact) banata hai aur sikhata hai ke algebra aur graph dono mein is ke saath kaise kaam karna hai.
Aap kya seekhenge: function kya hai; domain, co-domain aur range; \(f(x)\) wali notation aur values nikalna; vertical line test; one-to-one, onto, bijective aur piecewise functions; lines aur parabolas ke intersection points graph se; \(y = \sqrt{x}\) aur \(y = \sqrt[3]{x}\) ke graphs; aur real life mein growth aur decay.
Pehle se kya aana chahiye: expressions mein numbers rakhna (substitute karna), brackets kholna, linear aur quadratic equations hal karna, aur \(xy\)-plane par points lagana. Agar in mein se koi cheez kamzor hai to fikar na karein; har jagah hum chhote steps mein yaad dilate jayenge.

Sab se pehle thori si tareekh (history). Lafz function German mathematician Leibniz (1646-1716) ne is liye istemal kiya taa ke yeh bataya ja sake ke ek miqdaar (quantity) doosri miqdaar par kaise depend karti hai. Kitab do misaalein deti hai jin se pata chalta hai ke yeh lafz kaise use hota hai:

items: (i) Square (murabba) ka area \(A\) us ki ek side \(x\) par formula \(A = x^{2}\) ke zariye depend karta hai. Is liye hum kehte hain ke \(A\), \(x\) ka function hai.
(ii) Sphere (gend jaisi goal cheez) ka volume \(V\) us ke radius \(r\) par formula \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}\) ke zariye depend karta hai. Is liye hum kehte hain ke \(V\), \(r\) ka function hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
In dono formulas ko ghor se dekhiye. Har formula mein ek cheez hum apni marzi se chunte hain; ise input kehte hain. Doosri cheez phir khud ba khud tay ho jati hai; ise output kehte hain.
Square: side \(x = 3\) rakhein to area \(A = 3^{2} = 9\). Kya 3 side wale square ka area kabhi 9 ke ilawa kuch aur ho sakta hai? Bilkul nahin.
Sphere: radius \(r = 3\) rakhein to \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi (3)^{3} = 36\pi\). Yahan bhi sirf ek hi jawab.
Is liye "is a function of" ka matlab hamesha yeh hai: jaise hi input maloom ho jaye, output poori tarah tay ho jata hai. Koi shak, koi doosra option nahin.

Ab kitab ki definition: function ek aisa rule ya correspondence (rishta jorne ka tareeqa) hai jo do sets ko is tarah jorta hai ke pehle set ka har element doosre set ke sirf aur sirf ek (one and only one) element se jura ho.
Yani upar wali misaal (i) mein diye gaye side wale square ka sirf ek area hai, aur misaal (ii) mein diye gaye radius wale sphere ka sirf ek volume hai. Isi liye dono function hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Definition ke andar pehle set ke har element par do sharten (conditions) hain. Inhein alag alag samajh lein, kyun ke exam mein inhi par sawal bante hain:
1. Har element ka koi na koi partner doosre set mein hona chahiye (koi input khaali na rahe).
2. Har element ka sirf ek partner hona chahiye (kisi input ke do jawab na hon).
Roz marra ki misaal: class ke har student ka sirf ek roll number hota hai, is liye "student \(\to\) roll number" function hai. Lekin "insaan \(\to\) mobile number" aam tor par function nahin, kyun ke kisi ke paas do numbers hote hain (doosri shart toot gayi) aur chhote bachche ke paas koi number nahin hota (pehli shart toot gayi).
Ab ek ahem baat: do mukhtalif inputs ka output same ho sakta hai. Do students ka qad (height) barabar ho sakta hai, phir bhi "student \(\to\) height" function hai, kyun ke har student ka qad ek hi hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Neeche diye gaye rules mein se kaun se function hain?
(a) Har shehri \(\to\) us ka CNIC number.
(b) Har maa \(\to\) us ke bachche.
(c) Har din \(\to\) us din Lahore ka sab se zyada temperature.
Jawab: (a) function hai, har shehri ka ek hi CNIC hota hai. (b) function nahin, kyun ke kisi maa ke do ya zyada bachche hote hain, yani ek input ke kayi outputs. (c) function hai: har din ka sab se zyada temperature ek hi hota hai, chahe do dinon ka temperature barabar ho jaye.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Petrol ki misaal lete hain (yeh kitab ka sawal nahin, hamari practice hai). Farz karein ek litre ki qeemat 250 rupay hai. Agar \(x\) litre dalwayein to bill \(B = 250x\) rupay.
\(x = 2\) to \(B = 500\); \(x = 4\) to \(B = 1000\).
Kya ek hi miqdaar (jaise 2 litre) ke do mukhtalif bill ban sakte hain? Nahin. Is liye bill, litres ka function hai. Yahan input litre hain, output rupay hain, aur rule \(B = 250x\) hai.
Ab hum is idea ki baqaida (formal) definition ki taraf chalte hain, jo agle hisse 2.1.1 Definition mein hai. Wahan hum domain, range aur codomain ke naam bhi seekhenge.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Function ek rule hai jo har input ko bilkul ek output deta hai.
2. "\(A\), \(x\) ka function hai" ka matlab: \(A\) depend karta hai \(x\) par, aur \(x\) maloom hote hi \(A\) tay ho jata hai.
3. Pehle set ka har element use hona chahiye, aur har ek ka sirf ek partner.
4. Do inputs ka output same ho sakta hai; ek input ke do outputs kabhi nahin.
5. Function ka idea Leibniz (1646-1716) ne diya.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Yeh samajhna ke function mein har input ka output alag hona chahiye. Yeh ek khaas qisam (one-to-one) ki shart hai jo 2.1.4 mein aayegi. Aam function mein sirf yeh mana hai ke ek input ke do output hon.
2. Yeh bhool jana ke pehle set ka har element kisi na kisi se jura hona chahiye. Agar koi input khaali reh gaya to woh rule us set par function nahin.
3. Input aur output ki jagah ulat dena. "\(A\), \(x\) ka function hai" mein input \(x\) hai, \(A\) nahin. Bachne ka tareeqa: khud se poochhein "kaun si cheez main pehle chunta hoon?" Wohi input hai.
